sentences.text: Jeff Bezos -LRB- -LSB- ˈbeɪzoʊs -RSB- born Jeffrey Preston Jorgensen ; January 12 , 1964 -RRB- is an American technology and retail entrepreneur , investor , and philanthropist who is best known as the founder , chairman , and chief executive officer of Amazon.com , which is the world 's largest online shopping retailer .	Amazon.com	Amazon.com

The company began as an Internet merchant of books and expanded to a wide variety of products and services , most recently video streaming and audio streaming .	Internet	Internet	video streaming	Streaming media

Amazon.com is currently the world 's largest Internet sales company on the World Wide Web , as well as being the world 's largest provider of cloud infrastructure services , through its Amazon Web Services arm .	Amazon.com	Amazon.com	Internet	Internet	World Wide Web	World Wide Web	cloud infrastructure	cloud infrastructure	Amazon Web Services	Amazon Web Services
Bezos 's other diversified business interests include aerospace and newspapers .	aerospace	aerospace	newspapers	newspapers

He is the founder and manufacturer of Blue Origin -LRB- founded in 2000 -RRB- with test flights to space which started in 2015 , and plans for commercial suborbital human spaceflight beginning in 2018 .	Blue Origin	Blue Origin	test flights	flight test	suborbital	suborbital spaceflight	human spaceflight	human spaceflight
In 2013 , Bezos purchased The Washington Post newspaper .	The Washington Post	The Washington Post
A number of other business investments are managed through Bezos Expeditions .	Bezos Expeditions	Jeff Bezos#Bezos Expeditions

With an estimated net worth of US$ 82 billion as of May 2017 , Bezos is currently the third-richest person in the world , just behind Bill Gates and Amancio Ortega in first and second places , and just ahead of Warren Buffett in fourth place .	third-richest person in the world	The World's Billionaires	Bill Gates	Bill Gates	Amancio Ortega	Amancio Ortega	Warren Buffett	Warren Buffett
